text: {"assertions":["A spurious 429 rate limit error bug was discovered in the API gateway rate limiter in api/gateway/rate_limit.go on 2026-02-19.","The spurious 429 bug only occurred for tenants with more than 10,000 distinct keys.","The root cause of the spurious 429 bug was a mutable default argument that was shared across multiple function calls.","The fix involved changing the default to be empty and building the value freshly for each function call, implemented in PR #2936 on branch fix/spurious-429-1.","After the fix, the affected job's runtime improved from 4 hours to 70 minutes.","The bug was reproduced by replaying a saved burst fixture test case.","The issue was signaled by throttle counters measuring far above the configured ceiling.","The API gateway rate limiter is implemented in Go with test coverage in api/gateway/rate_limit_test.go."]}
